description: Lock the vault - clears master key from memory. Secrets cannot be accessed until unlocked again.
embedding_description: Vault: lock. Clear the master encryption key from process memory so stored secrets (passwords, credentials, OAuth client_secrets, API keys, refresh tokens, bearer tokens) become unreadable until unlock is called again with the passphrase. Use when handing the solet off, stepping away, or as a security boundary between trusted and untrusted execution contexts.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Vault lock result. Contains message (status) and unlocked (should be false). Master key cleared from memory.
result_processor_customizations.output_action_guidance: Determine the appropriate next action based on the context and action result.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Locks the vault by securely clearing the master key from memory. Prevents any further secret access until unlocked again.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: AlreadyLocked: Vault is already locked (not an error). InternalError: Unable to clear memory securely.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: For AlreadyLocked: Inform user vault is already secure. For InternalError: Serious issue - consider restarting the application.
